costGoal: small initial run; actual gateway pricing and costs verified separately; no guarantee of a hard monetary cap
failureRule: retain failed, incomplete and unknown calls; do not repeat an ambiguous timed-out call
design: same model, repository snapshot, task, baseline archive access and repo tools; only treatment receives a fresh Memex store and a model-driven historical intake before the task; isolated workspaces and randomized arm order
limitations: two tasks are a feasibility pilot, not an efficacy estimate
both tasks are paired shadows of actual work; no production deployment is performed
two AI reviewers are not human or verified independent providers
local preregistration is not an independently timestamped registration
